## Topsis_102003458 # TOPSIS Submitted By: **Anshika Singla_102003458**. Type: **Package**. Title: **TOPSIS method for multiple-criteria decision making (MCDM)**. Version: **1.0**. Author: **Anshika Singla**. Maintainer: **Anshika Singla **. Description: **Evaluation of alternatives based on multiple criteria using TOPSIS method.**. --- ## What is TOPSIS? **T**echnique for **O**rder **P**reference by **S**imilarity to **I**deal **S**olution (TOPSIS) originated in the 1980s as a multi-criteria decision making method. TOPSIS chooses the alternative of shortest Euclidean distance from the ideal solution, and greatest distance from the negative-ideal solution.
